item.tib: yang zab dmar khrid rdzogs pa che mkha' 'gro snying gi thig le las drang don thar pa'i 'jug sgo
item.coloph: ces rdzogs pa chen po mkha' 'gro snying thig dgongs pa rang grol gyi rgyud sngon du 'gro ba'i bon mchog drang don thar pa'i 'jug sgo 'di ni/ stabs kyi 'byor bas sa yi rgyal byin chen po rab brtan ser skya gang gis (gi) dur gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ shar rgyal mo rgya yi rang (rong) chen gyi dbus su mngon pa'i dmu rdo g.yung drung spungs rtse'i byang phyogs rab brtan rgyal po'i tha dru grong khyer ka ling ka'i 'dus sde chen po/ dga' ldan g.yung drung gling gi dbu rtse rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang su (du) / snyigs dus bstan 'gro'i dpal yon kun grol grags pa 'ja' tshon snying po can gyis rigs kyi bu mo rka rma spos dri can ma'i dgyes sde dang bcas te/ sa rta zla ba brgyad pa'i dkar phyogs su bgyis pa/ 'gro rnams smin grol gyi lam la 'khod pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig
